result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both pages have a clear hierarchy: a big headline, one main button, a quieter text link and a small stats footer. A wins on execution. B's headline breaks awkwardly after 'Bring', and its pale green button with white text has weak contrast. In both answers the bold parts of the stats line pull it up close to the weight of the supporting text, and A also adds a second 'How it works' link in the nav. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers lead clearly with the headline and use a sensible hierarchy. B's dark green button stands out much more against the cream background, and its 'How a repair cafe works' link is clearly quieter. A's pale green button with white text has weak contrast and competes less clearly for attention. B adds a small pill label and repeats 'How it works' in the nav, but these are light touches, and both answers bold parts of the stats line, which makes it slightly less quiet.
